id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1076: "But there was no need. Faris visibly changed. It's thanks to you. We're grateful.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|108d: "...But I know, you see. Faris secretly slips out to watch the circus at night.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1098: "He's training properly, so I think we can forgive that much. Hee hee.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11dd: "The prince? He should have gone to the Race House to enter the Faris Cup.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11eb: "Hm? The prince probably went back to his room to prepare to capture the monster.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11f7: "His room is down the stairs and to the left. Please be sure to be polite.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1209: "The prince seems to have left to capture the monster. He was very fired up. He's grown reliable.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|121a: "To think the prince hid his weak side for so long... I was completely fooled too.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1226: "...But from now on, Prince Faris will truly be a prince of the land of knights.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1235: "Since that incident the prince has changed. He trains hard, like a different person from the slacker he was.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1242: "At this rate he'll grow into a fine heir. I'm relieved.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|132a: "The Sultan was delighted with the prince at the Faris Cup!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1335: "Just when the race got everyone excited, the desert killer appears... We must tighten up again.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1346: "To try capturing the desert killer, the prince is truly amazing.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1353: "Oh, I heard! You ran in the race and beat the desert killer!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|135d: "You're Gallopolis's benefactors! Please visit our country again!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1431: "Prince Faris went to the throne room on the second floor. Go straight up the central stairs.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1441: "Prince Faris probably went to his room to prepare to fight the desert killer.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1453: "Prince Faris has already left to capture the desert killer.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|145e: "To set out so strongly against the desert killer... As expected of the prince.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|146f: "Since that incident the prince has turned over a new leaf, and, forgive me, I feel the Sultan has regained a knight's heart too.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|147f: "This is thanks to you. Thank you.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|156b: "S-strange... There's no way Prince Faris can ride a horse properly.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1574: "This might be an omen of disaster. I hope nothing bad happens...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1582: "The desert killer appears... and the prince leads the expedition? That's impossible.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|158f: "Ah, ah, the prince who can't run showed a fine ride, so I had a bad feeling. Will he really be okay?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15a0: "Hooray! Now I don't have to give the Sultan false reports praising the prince's achievements!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1647: "Now, follow the prince's strong, brave form at the Faris Cup and put some spirit into your training!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1659: "I hear the prince is going to capture the monster. And it's the desert killer!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1665: "As expected of our prince! Capturing the desert killer for the people, a true model knight.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1676: "You lot! Remember the prince's gallant form! Face any hardship fair and square... That is a knight's way of life!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|168a: "The Sultan ordered no mercy, even for Prince Faris!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1692: "Now, put spirit into your swords! At this rate, joining General Hendrik's Heliodor unit is a pipe dream!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|172e: "S-so this instructor's harsh training is a chance to grow too... Fair and square in any hardship... huff...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1741: "The Faris Cup was a wonderful race! We had no idea the prince could ride like that.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|174e: "Someday I want to be a fine knight who enters the Faris Cup, so I'll train hard!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|175e: "I hear Prince Faris is setting out for the Celestial Sands, a famed danger zone, to capture the desert killer!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|176d: "We green knights can't join the prince yet, but we're cheering from here!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|177b: "Even the prince worked that hard. I can do it too. Hardship is a chance to grow. Sniff...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|178b: "Training alongside that prince, what an honor as a knight! I can brag to my family! I'll do my best!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|183e: "Our instructor tells us to follow the prince at the Faris Cup, but racing and sword training are totally different!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1851: "The prince is as young as me, yet he's going to capture the desert killer. Amazing. I could never.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1864: "Seeing the prince fight made me want to try harder. A heart that doesn't give up is what matters!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1871: "...Still, that entertainer's swordplay. I've never seen anything so amazing. I hope I can do that someday.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1880: "That popular prince is being drilled where I always train. It feels strange somehow...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|190c: "The Sultan seems satisfied with Prince Faris's performance.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1913: "...But between us, the prince in the race didn't seem like a prince.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1922: "The Sultan seems pleased with Prince Faris's performance at the racetrack, but...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|192b: "Even veteran knights can't beat it, and he orders the prince to capture the desert killer? That's too reckless.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|193c: "I'm glad the Sultan and Sultana realized their mistake in this affair. The country will only get better.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|194f: "I'm glad the prince trains properly now, like it's my own joy. I can't believe how much he changed.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|195b: "His swordsmanship is still green... but his form isn't bad at all! He'll make a fine knight!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19a5: "The current Sultan too ran at sixteen in the big race named for him, showing the world his royal stature.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19b5: "With this race, Prince Faris surely won the people's high praise. We who serve the castle can relax.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19ca: "The Celestial Sands, where the prince is headed, has a place where strange stone pillars stand in a circle.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19ed: "Records say the Rainbough was received from Dundrasil in ancient times and kept as Gallopolis's national treasure.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19fb: "But how it was made, or how Dundrasil came to own it, is not clear.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1af0: "...Prince Faris should be with the Sultan.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1af7: "But it's strange. The prince can't possibly ride properly. Maybe it'll snow in the desert.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b05: "Prince Faris went into his room with a pale face.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b0f: "Prince Faris suddenly perked up and set out in high spirits... What kind of magic did you use?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b20: "Out of consideration for the prince at play, I told the Sultan the lie that he was away training. Now I don't have to!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b2e: "We can only thank you! Thank you so much!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b3b: "Why, if it isn't {var:1}. The prince should be hard at training at the training grounds now.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b46: "Please do meet him. The prince will surely be glad.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ba5: "I'd like to say I'm relieved the Faris Cup ended without incident, but...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bae: "Something feels stuck in my throat. I can't shake the unease.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bb9: "Even veteran knights can't, so can the prince really capture the desert killer...? I'm worried.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bcb: "The prince seemed so earnest, yet he was actually a dud... I still can't believe it.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bd4: "Still, the Sultan and prince both seem very remorseful, so I'm relieved. The country's future is bright.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c6b: "The prince at the Faris Cup seemed different from usual. He must have been really fired up!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c7a: "The desert killer is that scorpion monster everyone fears, right? Scary... I hope no one else gets hurt.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c8a: "A lot seems to have happened, but it feels settled. Now I can work in peace!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d3d: "I was appointed to the monster capture party... I might not come back alive. But this is a knight's sad fate.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d4c: "Ah, if I'm going to die, I'd rather win the horse race and die buried in prize money...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d5a: "Oh, you helped us at the Celestial Sands. Without you, neither the prince nor I would have been fine. Thanks.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e26: "Heh... The day has come to test the results of my daily training!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e2e: "I'll surely capture the desert killer and earn glory!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e3a: "When I joined the prince's expedition I resigned myself to never returning alive... You saved me. Thank you.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ebe: "Hmm... Against that desert killer, I'd like to go to the front, but I can't leave here.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ece: "Well, I hear it was you who ran in the race. We truly owe you. Thank you.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f29: "La la la~ Prince Faris~ Smash enemies like thunder~ For Gallopolis's pride~♪
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f33: "Prince Faris is going on an expedition, so I was composing a cheering song, but it's not quite working. Hmm...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f46: "La la la~ Prince Faris~ Noble heart that never breaks~ Carve Gallopolis's tomorrow~♪
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f50: "Prince Faris's fighting stirred me, so I was composing a song to praise him. I look forward to his growth.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2052: "That soldier over there was hurt by the desert killer.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|205b: "To do this to a proud Gallopolis knight, what a vicious monster. But I'll defeat it in his place.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|206d: "Thanks to you, the prince has reformed. We truly owe you.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|211c: "It's an honorable duty for a knight, but fighting the desert killer while babysitting that prince is depressing...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21b6: "The desert killer... I wanted to fight it just once, but my duty is protecting the Sultan.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21c3: "I'll leave this expedition to the prince. He will surely capture the desert killer.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21d7: "You don't look that strong, yet I hear you captured the desert killer... I'm truly impressed.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21e2: "With that strength you could be a palace knight. ...How about it? Want to be a knight?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21ee: "Ha ha ha! I thought so. You have your reasons for traveling. Don't get cocky about your strength, and travel safely.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21fe: "Ha ha ha! Just joking! You have your reasons for traveling. Don't get cocky about your strength, and travel safely.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2234: "Prince Faris did so well that the Sultan seems very satisfied.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|223a: "The prince's popularity will only rise from here.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2244: "Suddenly it's noisy since the desert killer appeared. This castle is safe, right...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2254: "The cats seem happy too. They must be glad the prince reformed.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22b4: "Oh, what should I do? I can't find Princess Furris the cat. Where on earth did she go?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22bc: "She's been gone so long. I hope nothing bad has happened...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22c9: "This knight was attacked by the desert killer on patrol at the Celestial Sands. Thankfully he's alive...
